A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 23-page ReDi paper, including Appendices A–G. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison establish complete correspondence of the scientific text, equations, figures, and tables.

before.justification: v2 reports original ImageNet generation experiments, including conditional and unconditional results and ablations in Section 4, detailed benchmarks in Appendix C, and qualitative results in Appendix G.

after.justification: v3 retains the original ReDi experimental outcomes in Section 4 and the quantitative and qualitative results in Appendices C and G.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Appendix A retain identical joint image-feature modeling, token-fusion alternatives, PCA reduction, Representation Guidance, and DiT/SiT training objectives and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same ImageNet 256 × 256 coverage for class-conditional and unconditional generation. No datasets, tasks, domains, or evaluation scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain identical comparator membership, including DiT, SiT, REPA, and the autoregressive and latent-diffusion baselines in Table 2. Appendix C's comparator rows also match.

E3.justification: Section 4.1 and the appendices retain the same preprocessing, model configurations, training budgets, guidance settings, 250-step sampling procedures, and 50,000-sample evaluation using FID, sFID, IS, precision, and recall.

E4.justification: The Representation Guidance comparisons, PCA-component ablation, token-fusion comparison, CFG-channel analysis, and Appendix G's guidance-weight examples are identical. No supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions present the same point estimates and curves. Neither reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or statistical significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results, curves, and qualitative samples match. For example, Table 2 retains ReDi's FID of 1.61 at 800 epochs, and Appendix C's Table 10 retains REPA+ReDi's FID of 3.5 at 1M iterations.

T1.justification: Equations 1–18 are unchanged, including the joint denoising objectives, Representation Guidance derivation, and Appendix A's stochastic-interpolant formulation. No definitions, assumptions, or mathematical reasoning are revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions, and conclusion retain identical claims about joint image-feature synthesis, improved generation quality, accelerated convergence, and Representation Guidance for conditional and unconditional generation.

C2.justification: The interpretations of dimensionality reduction, token-fusion efficiency, and guidance remain identical. Appendices E–F retain the same discussion of alternative representations, compression approaches, and potential misuse.

D1.justification: Section 4.1 and Appendix B retain identical implementation disclosures, including PCA preparation, optimization settings, eight A100 GPUs, and REPA integration details. The project/code link is unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix D, and the bibliography are identical. Positioning relative to REPA, multimodal generation, and VideoJam remains unchanged, with no cited works added or removed.

P1.justification: Only the first-page arXiv identification changes from v2 dated 1 September 2025 to v3 dated 22 January 2026, with its corresponding self-link updated. Body wording, headings, and document organization are identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–16, Tables 1–10, captions, and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages 2–23 are pixel-identical; the first-page difference is confined to the version/date stamp, with no substantive layout change.

improvement.justification: v3 changes only the arXiv version/date identification and corresponding self-link. The main text and Appendices A–G preserve identical methods, evidence, explanations, reproducibility details, and limitations, leaving overall paper quality unchanged.
